propositions: Eleven near-duplicate CLI verbs (exists, format, check-ac, clarity-check, quality-check, tag, untag, get-file-impact, get-verify-commands, list-descendants, session-logs) must be merged into six canonical verbs (check, resolve, show, deps, edit, list) with a hard cutover and no working aliases.
Removed spellings must fail loudly with exit 2, displaying the old name and a replacement hint via a populated _REMOVED_SPELLINGS dict mapping old names to new spellings.
resolve_cli signature must change from (argv, tracker) to (argv, tracker, repo_root) and the resolve route adapter must flip to argv_tracker_root to support the folded --display flag.
check_cli must be a new 3-arg entry point that parses --ac/--clarity/default flags and delegates to unchanged check_ac_cli, clarity_check_cli, and quality_check_cli handlers.
list must gain a --limit N option applied after sort_states, and recent_session_logs_state must use sort_states(logs, '-created')[:limit] to align library, MCP, and CLI ordering.
All 16 removed spellings (11 new plus 5 historical) must route through route_for() as None and parametrized dispatch tests must verify exit 2 + hint for all cases.
